content.thinking:
I'm checking each claim against the figures and cause: the outage affecting account pages, the peak error rate, and the estimated loss to takings are all supported. The responder and engineer minutes also check out. The claim that Argus reverted the monthly-spend flag and that it is still in place is the one I'm still verifying.

The last check is whether the revert really worked, since Some Person resolved the incident first from PagerDuty, leaving the flag off and paging the checkout team. The go-wrong field is absent and the rest of the claims all hold up.
